evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 3. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Zero experience and explicitly broad entry foundations fit the technical foundational rubric despite an associate hint; accreditation and high pricing do not supply evidence of applied domain ownership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Broad entry technologies, accreditation and proctoring provide a credible technical foundation. With zero experience, limited hiring uptake and no recorded practical assessment, the associate hint does not justify stronger operational seniority.

alex-novak.rationale: The record explicitly describes broad entry cybersecurity technologies with zero experience. Accreditation and SANS association do not raise introductory technical foundations to associate practice.
